'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Chris Menzel DS Hunt Down''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Hunt Down and Destroy zee Germans. Spreadsheet 'Hunt Down and Destroy zee Germans' Worlds 2014 23.08.2014 V 9.02. I Have You Now (V) fully struck (header Interrupts 24 matches remaining). Weapon Of A Sith crossed on shields (14 shields remain). The Mandalorian, Father of Fett (V) → Jango Fett (V) (vb5 lore nickname; same as Aaron Day 2). After Her (V) → After Her! (V). Surface Defense (V) is the 1/2 Hand Start. Starting 6 include objective, Holotheatre, Meditation Chamber (V), Visage, Surface Defense (V), Knowledge And Defense (V). Reserve qty 60 excluding shields.
